item.title: Review: Blade Runner 2099: fans will have no idea what is happening in this sci-fi sequel. Why is it even on TV?
item.description: If you’re a cyberpunk who loves ennui and watching actors you can’t see speak words you can’t hear, get stuck in! The rest of us will just be baffled and bored Why is James Bond not a TV series by now? Harry Potter, Lord of the Rings, Alien, Star Wars – all given the TV treatment. Franchise-mining is fantastic business, maximising attention share in order to sell adverts. So why not Bond, which is co-owned by Amazon? Maybe watching a punchy sex addict every week, saying his name with weirdly administrative syntax, might just be … too much? item.title: Review: Cathedrals of sound: the secret universe inside musical instruments – in pictures
item.description: Photographer and former cellist Charles Brooks creates optical illusions with minuscule cameras.
